# Disintegration splatters (magical gibs)

When an actor is **gibbed** by a *magical* killing blow (a damaging spell) — a
hit dealing at least 120% of its maximum health — it **disintegrates** rather
than being butchered, and is replaced by one of the special splatters in this
folder (instead of a blood stain from `../blood_stains/`).

## Provide your own

Two author-supplied images are expected here; the files currently shipped are
**placeholders** (an ashen arcane scorch) generated by
`python -m game.tools.make_sprites` — replace them with your own art.

The same two rules as the blood-stain folder apply:

1. **Order = severity.** Files are sorted by filename and treated as
   **mild → severe** (e.g. `1_mild.png`, `2_severe.png`); the game picks by how
   far the killing blow overshot the victim's health.
2. **Any count works** — two files is fine, more is fine.

Images are drawn flat on the ground (top-down); a square, transparent-background
splatter reads best.
